analysis: Test setup explicitly injects Dispatchers.IO; default lateEngine also uses Dispatchers.IO.

ModelTransactions creates its own SupervisorJob + io scope. lockControl also uses SupervisorJob + io. The blocked inspection and lock pushes therefore complete on real threads outside runTest virtual scheduling.
Original withTimeout(500L) inherits runTest scheduler. The actual error explicitly reports virtual time, with the testcase lasting only 0.032 seconds.

withContext(Dispatchers.Default) gives the same 500 ms timeout a real dispatcher and retains suspension while IO work completes. Existing neighboring handshake/lock race tests already use this pattern.

Five wrappers cover the locking-push poll, blocked-inspect deadline, locked-push poll, blocked-load deadline and late-binding locked-push poll across four unchanged test identities. No production edits or increased timeout.
